questions.question: Which house does the Sorting Hat put Harry in?
questions.note: The hat takes a while. Harry asks it not to put him in the house it is leaning toward.

questions.question: Harry begs the Sorting Hat to keep him out of which house?
questions.note: Harry's pleading is what tips it. Dumbledore later says our choices show who we are.

questions.question: Which house is Draco Malfoy in?
questions.note: He offers Harry friendship on the train, then becomes the rival instead.

questions.question: What Quidditch position does Harry play?
questions.note: Oliver Wood wants him thinking about one thing only: the Golden Snitch.

questions.question: What does the Seeker have to catch to end the game?
questions.note: Catching it ends the match. Chasers score with the Quaffle. Beaters handle the Bludgers.

questions.question: What broom does Professor McGonagall give Harry for the team?
questions.note: His first broom. The Firebolt comes later, as a gift from Sirius.

questions.question: Who is headmaster of Hogwarts when Harry arrives?
questions.note: McGonagall is deputy headmistress. She becomes head later, after his death.

questions.question: What does Professor Snape teach in Harry's early years?
questions.note: He wants Defense Against the Dark Arts for years and only gets it in the sixth film.

questions.question: What does Professor McGonagall teach?
questions.note: She is also head of Gryffindor. She is the cat Harry first meets on Privet Drive.

questions.question: What creature do Harry and Ron knock out in the girls' bathroom on Halloween?
questions.note: Quirrell sends the school into a panic, and they find Hermione stuck in the bathroom with the troll. The three of them are friends after that.
